attributes.title: 01 - Kubernetes Operations Overview
attributes.description: Cluster-wide operational overview from k8s-logs-* records: log volume, severity, namespaces, pods, and nodes observed in the selected time range. Counts are log-derived; this export has no Kubernetes metrics, resource capacity, readiness, or APM data.

attributes.title: 02 - Cluster Capacity and Nodes
attributes.description: Log-based node and workload activity view. This data can show which nodes and pods emitted logs, but cannot report CPU or memory usage, requests/limits, allocatable capacity, node readiness, or saturation without Kubernetes metrics.

attributes.title: 03 - Workload Health
attributes.description: Workload health signals derived from logs: errors, warnings, noisy pods, recurring messages, and last-seen activity. These are not pod health probes, restart counts, or Kubernetes readiness states.

attributes.title: 04 - Pod and Container Performance
attributes.description: Log-activity drill-down for pods and containers: line volume over time, error/warning counts, stream split, and busiest sources. These log-volume proxies are not CPU, memory, network, or latency metrics.

attributes.title: 05 - Application Services and APM
attributes.description: Application/service triage using the available Kubernetes log fields (namespace, pod, container, level, and message). The export contains no APM transactions, traces, service maps, latency, or throughput metrics; use the dashboard query bar to filter to an application namespace or pod.

attributes.title: 06 - Kubernetes Logs and Events
attributes.description: Log exploration and logging-pipeline freshness: stream and level breakdown, ingestion activity, recent records, and last-seen sources. This export contains application/container logs, not Kubernetes API Event objects.

attributes.title: 07 - Control Plane
attributes.description: Control-plane log view scoped to kubernetes.namespace_name: "kube-system". It shows only matching records available in k8s-logs-*; control-plane metrics, component health, API-server request metrics, and etcd metrics are not included.

attributes.title: 08 - Active Alerts and Incident Investigation
attributes.description: Incident triage from error and warning log signals, including affected pods, recurring messages, and recent records. This export has no Kibana alert-rule state or alert documents, so panels are investigation signals and do not represent active alert status.

Real-time log view across all pods, with separate SonarQube, Nexus, and PostgreSQL log-count panels and API request/failure log searches. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds. API tables use common ECS field names when present and message-text fallback; confirm mappings. All values are log-derived, not service health, latency SLOs, database performance, or alert state.
